_why: discovery-coverage (the researcher, 2026-10-18): every run row carries one small cell per scope channel - filled where the run has stored results, hatched where it never ran, amber while running, red where it failed - so 'CH1 has results, CH2 does not' is visible at a glance. Populated once a template run is done (the smoke flows make one); the empty arm is the runs list itself

discovery-coverage (Q44): each template card in Apply template carries a small ring - green interesting + seed, red not interesting + artifact, grey unsure, over every human verdict on its detections; the counts are in the tooltip, never a percentage on the face; an empty ring says 'no verdicts yet'
